hypothesis.statement: Rising Average True Range (ATR) marks conviction-driven moves where volatility is expanding. When ATR(14) exceeds ATR(14) from 10 bars ago, the market is in a volatility-expansion regime; trading in the direction of the 14-bar price trend during such regimes harvests the tendency for trending continuation when moves are accompanied by genuine range expansion.
hypothesis.expected_sign: positive mean spot return in the signal direction net of 15bps
hypothesis.mechanism_detail: ATR (rolling mean of True Range over N bars) captures effective intraday price range. A rising ATR — current ATR above ATR from LAG bars ago — signals that participants are increasingly willing to move prices, consistent with structural trend rather than noise. The signal follows the N-bar return direction only during ATR expansion; it is flat during contraction.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: ATR(14) > ATR(14).shift(10) has no predictive power for the direction of forward BTC spot returns.
hypothesis.known_caveats_at_registration: OHLCV dependency: True Range requires daily high and low; close-only data is insufficient. hold_days discrepancy: IS battery used hold_days=1 (daily re-evaluation); forward collection uses hold_days=7 to reduce turnover — IS and forward Sharpe/DSR are NOT directly comparable. No lockbox exists for Phase B signals; the IS/OOS 70/30 split is the only held-out estimate; DSR accounts for multiple-testing inflation across 34 trials.
hypothesis.role_note: Edge role: all 7 Candidate edge gate checks PASS on R2 (0c7e1bf9, 2026-06-25). Sharpe 0.49, WF 67%, sensitivity 60% (3/5 variants), LOO 100%, breakeven 50bps. v5 sensitivity variant {n=21, lag=20} was the enabling addition.

function_spec.name: ATR Expansion
function_spec.data_source: Binance BTCUSDT spot OHLCV (1m bars resampled to daily; requires high, low, close)
function_spec.flat_condition: ATR not expanding (current <= lagged ATR), OR NaN inputs (warmup < MIN_HISTORY=25), OR zero N-day return
function_spec.hold_days_note: IS Phase B battery used SignalSpec.hold_days=1 (continuous daily re-evaluation). Forward collection uses hold_days=7 to reduce turnover. IS and forward Sharpe/DSR are NOT directly comparable; the Validated gate evaluates forward returns only.
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled exit at entry + 7 calendar days; signal re-evaluated at exit for re-entry; no intra-hold exits
function_spec.trade_counting_definition: each 7-day evaluation window is one trade; sequential and non-overlapping
function_spec.ohlcv_note: True Range = max(H-L, |H-prev_C|, |L-prev_C|) requires genuine daily high and low. load_daily_ohlcv() provides these via max(high) and min(low) aggregation over 1m bars — NOT last() for high and low. This is verified by tests OL02 and OL03.
function_spec.sensitivity_note: 3/5 variants PASS (sign-stable vs. canonical Sharpe +0.49): v2 (+0.68), v4 (+0.61), v5 (+0.25). v1 (-0.17) and v3 (-0.04) FAIL. sens_pass_frac=0.60 exactly meets the 60% edge-candidate threshold. v5 {n=21, lag=20} was the critical Phase 1 addition (2026-06-25) that flipped sensitivity from 2/4=0.50 FAIL to 3/5=0.60 PASS.
function_spec.governance_phase: Candidate edge — forward evidence collection pending Phase 4 run_daily.py integration

observation_floors.rationale: Edge role, hold_days=7; ~52 trade opportunities per year maximum. n=26 corresponds to ~6 months. Both expanding-uptrend (long) and expanding-downtrend (short) legs must be observed to confirm both entry conditions.

content: DSR on non-overlapping 7-day forward trade returns (compute when n >= 26)

The DSR minimum n >= 26 is a governance criterion DISTINCT from the observation floor minimum_trades = 26. The two coincide numerically for this family and are NOT conflated: the observation floor governs admissibility, the DSR minimum governs when DSR/BH may be computed. FR-5's three minima remain separate, and n >= 5 stays the mathematical computability guard which never establishes sufficiency. Adopted at FB-10b-O (FDB-8 Option A, human-authorized).
